title: Barnacle Parking Enforcement invoices and statements (Village Of Chicago Ridge)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Illinois Freedom of Information Act., I request the following records concerning use of the "Barnacle" windshield immobilizer supplied by ITSA Solutions, LLC d/b/a Barnacle Parking Enforcement ("Barnacle"), for the period January 1, 2026 through June 30, 2026:

1. All invoices from Barnacle, and records of payment on them.
2. All statements, remittance advices, settlement or payout reports, or similar records showing money that Barnacle or its payment processor collected from motorists and paid, credited, or retained for any purpose. This includes records showing fines collected, deposits collected, refunded, or forfeited, surcharges and convenience fees Barnacle kept, and offsets for chargebacks, refunds, or lost or damaged devices.
3. If no record responsive to item 2 exists, a transaction report for the period exported from the Barnacle dashboard or management system.
4. The signed Order or other agreement with Barnacle in effect during the period, with any amendments and pricing schedules.

This request includes records held by any contractor that operates parking enforcement on behalf of Village Of Chicago Ridge. Where records exist as spreadsheets or CSV files, please produce them in that format. If Village Of Chicago Ridge did not use the Barnacle during this period, please say so.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

If you withhold or redact any record, please cite the specific FOIA exemption for each withholding.

Sincerely,

HCvP
